approved_findings.description: get_malfind (volatility3.windows.malfind.Malfind) reported 15 RWX VAD regions total; 10 of them in winlogon.exe (PID 628, ppid 628 winlogon), vad_tag VadS, protection PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE.
